name: Void Sight
text: You're accustomed to living or working in utter darkness, and your eyes have adjusted to the gloom. You gain greater darkvision.

name: Void Stalker
text: Requirements You're hidden to at least one enemy. You can strike fear into those you stalk simply by letting them know that you can see them, but they can't see you. You [[/act sneak]] or [[/act hide]] and verbally mock a single creature within 30 feet from whom you're hidden. Your Stealth check against that target's Perception DC gains the following success and failure results in addition to its usual results. Critical Success The target you mock becomes Frightened 2. The target can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 until 1 minute passes or until it observes you (whichever comes first). Success The target you mock becomes Frightened 1. Critical Failure You become observed to the target you mock.

name: Void Vision
text: Your time spent stuck to the hull of a traveling starship has made you hypersensitive to even the faintest traces of light. You gain darkvision.

name: Voidpath
text: You've unlocked a deeper connection to the depths of emptiness that voidborns call home. This connection allows you to travel through hidden spaces while avoiding the attention of others. While undetected by all non-allies in an area of dim light or darkness, you can [[/act sneak]] without attempting a Stealth check so long as you move less than 15 feet and don't pass within 15 feet of an enemy during your movement. During exploration, this also allows you to automatically approach within 20 feet of other creatures while Avoiding their Notice in an area of dim light or darkness, as long as they aren't actively Searching or on guard.

name: Voidstrong
text: Your unbelievable resilience allows you to survive even in the vacuum of space—at least for a while. You can hold your breath for 10 minutes. You have cold resistance equal to half your level. Special If you have the glacierborn shobhad heritage, your cold resistance is instead equal to your level. If you have the offworld shobhad heritage, you additionally gain the Breath Control general feat.

name: Volosian Spit
text: You've inherited a greater connection to your Volosian heritage and begin to exhibit hymothoa habits. You gain the Volosian Spit action.

name: Voracious Bite
text: You slurp residual nutrients as you dissolve those you bite. Whenever you inflict persistent poison damage with your jaws unarmed attack, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level for 1 minute. Special If you have the Suskillon Cutoff Shirren heritage, whenever you inflict persistent poison damage with your jaws unarmed attack, you also gain a +2 status bonus to your next Recall Knowledge check to recall information about creatures with the same trait as the target for the next minute.

name: Voracious Reader
text: When a topic draws your interest, you learn all you can about it but can just as easily shift to a new subject at the drop of a hat. Gain the feat. During your daily preparations, if you have access to the infosphere or any relevant learning material, you can swap the Lore skill you have selected with your Additional Lore feat (including any additional skill increases applied to that Lore skill using Additional Lore). Since the proficiency from this selection is temporary, you can't use it to satisfy a prerequisite for a permanent character option (like a feat).

name: Vulkari Item Hack
text: You can use your knowledge of computer coding and machine learning to hack magical items, enabling you to operate these powerful items even if you lack any magical talent. You gain the skill feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. When you Trick Magic Item, you can choose to use Computers instead of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion for the skill check, regardless of the item's magic tradition.

name: Vulkari Linguist
text: You are a skilled linguist and translator, with the uncanny ability to detect linguistic nuances, understand local parlance and metaphor, interpret nonverbal body language and communication, and ensure you're understood by those around you when it really counts, even when speaking a language they don't know. You gain two additional languages of your choice. Your linguistic effects work on targets who share a language with you, even if you aren't certain which language you share or aren't using the shared language.

name: Vulkari Spell Decipher
text: You understand that magic is just another language, and you can recognize and decode even magic outside of your spellcasting tradition. You gain the skill feat. When you Recognize Spell and you don't automatically identify the spell, you select which of the listed skill checks the GM rolls secretly to identify the spell, rather than the GM rolling whichever corresponds to the tradition of the spell being cast. In addition, you can get a result better than failure if you're not trained in the skill.

name: Wall Jump
text: You can kick off walls to keep moving upward. While Climbing or High Jumping, you can push off a wall to extend your reach, gaining extra height or distance.

name: Warblood of Damoritosh
text: The vesk deity of conquest, Damoritosh, has gifted (or cursed) you with the divine energy to persevere through the most intense combat situations. The first time each day that you would die, Damoritosh protects you, granting you a sliver of healing and the drive to push through the coming challenge. This prevents you from dying, restores ] Hit Points, and you become Quickened for 1 minute. If the cause of your death was a condition or effect that would still cause you to die after regaining Hit Points, such as a high value on the doomed condition, you suppress that condition for 1 minute.

name: Ward Medic
text: You've studied in large medical wards, treating several patients at once and tending to all their needs. When you use Treat Disease or Treat Wounds, you can treat up to two targets. If you're a master in Medicine, you can treat up to four targets, and if you're legendary, you can treat up to eight targets.

name: Warmount Shell
text: Your immense shell has the capability to mount weapons of destructive power like other species might wield in their arms. You count as having an additional pair of arms that can only be used to hold a single two-handed weapon. This weapon is implanted as an augmentation but doesn't count toward your implant limit and can be removed with an Interact action.

name: Warp Field Surge
text: Your quantum field becomes a weapon. While your quantum field is active, as a single action you can cause it to pulse — all enemies within the field take 3d6 force damage (Reflex save for half). Usable once per activation of the field.

name: Warp Wounds
text: Trigger An enemy damages you. Requirements An enemy or willing ally is in your quantum field. Your reality shifts to partly overlap with another in which someone else was injured in your stead. You gain resistance to all damage against the triggering attack equal to half your level, and one enemy or willing ally in your quantum field takes damage of the same type equal to the amount of damage prevented this way, with a fortitude|against:witchwarper|basic save against your class DC.

name: Warp Wounds
text:
Trigger An enemy damages you.

Requirements An enemy or willing ally is in your quantum field.

Your reality shifts to partly overlap with another in which someone else was injured in your stead. You gain resistance to all damage against the triggering attack equal to half your level, and one enemy or willing ally in your quantum field takes damage of the same type equal to the amount of damage prevented this way, with a save against your class DC.

name: Warping Presence
text:
Frequency once per day

You surround yourself with alien energy that warps the space around those nearby, hindering their attempts to move unless they find a way to resist the effect. For 1 minute, you gain a warping presence aura in a 20-foot emanation around you. Enemies who enter the aura (or are in the aura when you activate it) must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC with the following results. Afterwards, they are temporarily immune for 1 minute.

 Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success Every space in your aura is difficult terrain for the creature for 1 round.

Failure Every space in your aura is difficult terrain for the creature for 1 minute.

Critical Failure Every space in your aura is greater difficult terrain for the creature for 1 minute.

name: Wary Disarmament
text: If you trigger a device or set off a trap while disarming it, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC or saving throw against the device or trap. This applies only to attacks or effects triggered by your failed attempt, not to any later ones, such as additional attacks from a complex trap.

name: Waste Not
text: With careful focus, you guarantee vital energy lost from a target is caught by your vitality network. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals void damage to a living creature, your vitality network gains Hit Points equal to twice the spell's rank. Special You can Waste Not without the spellshape trait. If you do and your next action is to Strike with a weapon that deals void damage, your vitality network gains 2 Hit Points per weapon damage die.

name: Waste Not
text:
With careful focus, you guarantee vital energy lost from a target is caught by your vitality network. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals void damage to a living creature, your vitality network gains Hit Points equal to twice the spell's rank.

Special You can Waste Not without the spellshape trait. If you do and your next action is to Strike with a weapon that deals void damage, your vitality network gains 2 Hit Points per weapon damage die.

name: Wasteland Warrior
text: Pioneers have overcome many of the wastelands' dangers, gaining both resilience and the skills needed to survive there. You gain resistance to cold and fire damage equal to half your level. You can disable environmental hazards using [[/act disable-device skill=survival]] instead of Athletics or Thievery. If you're a master in Survival, you can disable environmental hazards that require a proficiency rank of master or lower in Athletics or Thievery.

name: Watch Out
text: Trigger A creature targets an ally within 60 feet with an attack, and you can see both the attacker and your ally. You signal a warning to your ally, granting them a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

name: Watch Out
text:
Trigger A creature targets an ally within 60 feet with an attack, and you can see both the attacker and your ally.

You signal a warning to your ally, granting them a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

name: Watch Your Back
text: You warn allies of incoming threats. When you use a directive, you can also grant one ally within 60 feet a +2 circumstance bonus to their next AC check until the start of your next turn.

name: Water Mastery
text:
Frequency once per hour

You call upon your mastery of water to create waves and currents that guide you along, increasing your swim Speed, as well as that of your allies and even allied vehicles. For 10 minutes, you and all allied creatures and vehicles within 50 feet of you gain a +30-foot status bonus to swim Speed, to a maximum of double the given creature's original swim Speed.

Allies without a swim Speed instead move twice as far on a successful Swim check. In most cases, this benefit means that on a critical success, they move 20 feet, plus 5 feet per 10 feet of their land Speed, and on a success they move 10 feet, plus 5 feet per 10 feet of their land Speed.

Effect: Water Mastery

name: Weakening Shot
text: Requirements You're wielding a gun. You target a creature's limbs or load-bearing appendages to weaken them. You Aim and then make a ranged Strike against your mark. If the Strike hits, the creature becomes your choice of Clumsy 1 or Enfeebled 1 until the end of your next turn (Clumsy 2 or Enfeebled 2 on a critical hit).

name: Weakening Shot
text:
Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You target a creature's limbs or load-bearing appendages to weaken them. You Aim and then make a ranged Strike against your mark. If the Strike hits, the creature becomes your choice of Clumsy 1 or Enfeebled 1 until the end of your next turn (Clumsy 2 or Enfeebled 2 on a critical hit).

name: Weapon Proficiency
text: You become trained in all martial weapons. If you were already trained in all martial weapons, you become trained in one advanced weapon of your choice. If you are at least 11th level, you also become an expert in these weapons. Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you become trained in an advanced weapon.

name: Weave Obscurity
text: You understand your affliction enough to wield your inability to communicate certain things as a shield against prying eyes, adorning yourself with imagery of pre-Gap truths that are obscured to most people. You can cast Invisibility as a 2nd-rank occult innate spell three times per day, but the spell's duration becomes "until the end of your next turn."

name: Web Trap
text: You spin restraining webs in an instant. As a single action, you can target one creature within 15 feet with a web that imposes the grabbed condition on a failed Reflex save (DC = 10 + level + DEX modifier).

name: Weightless Defense
text: Requirements You're Untethered in zero gravity. You have learned kasathan techniques that takes advantage of your extra arms for increasing your defense in zero gravity. You curl yourself into a tight ball, using one set of arms to balance and one set of arms to protect yourself. You lose the Off-Guard condition from being untethered, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saves for as long as you're untethered or until you use an action with the manipulate trait. Special If you're a void acolyte kasatha, you don't lose the benefits of Weightless Defense by using an action with the manipulate trait.

name: Well of Vitality
text: Your flowering is a reservoir of incredible vitality energy. Once per day, you can cast Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Hnc7eGi7vyZenAIm as a primal innate spell.

name: Well-Connected
text: You've studied the dense and interconnected network of kasathan Great Families. You know all their major achievements, and you can use this knowledge either to flatter or to find the right person for a job, depending on what the situation calls for. You become trained in Society and gain the Streetwise skill feat. In addition, when you're in a settlement with a significant kasatha population, you can request help or expertise by meeting with a member of a Great Family; when you do so, you gain a +2 status bonus to Society checks to Gather Information.

name: Well-Loved Trinket
text: Frequency once per day One of your personal trinkets has aged from years of love and wear. Looking at it reminds you of times when you were safe and filled with joy, such as when you were a child listening to stories of heroic triumph. When you use the Self Soothe action, you also reduce your Doomed value by 1. You cannot use this to reduce a permanent doomed value.

name: Weren't You At That Party?
text: No matter where you go, there's always a few people you've met before at a party, and you can meet up with them to try to get some help or a favor or two. After 1 day of downtime after reaching a new settlement, you can shake up some contacts from prior parties or just go to a few parties and meet new ones. You can somehow achieve this in just 1 hour if you are legendary in Society. Once you have done so, or if you are in a settlement where you have previously partied and established contacts, you can attempt a Society check to arrange a meeting with someone else with whom you once partied, or ask for a favor in exchange for a later favor of your contact's choice. The GM decides the DC based on the specifics of the favor and the figure's prominence.

name: What's Mine is Yours
text: Frequency once per round You have little regard for the concepts of personal space and individual ownership, and you often place your equipment in your allies' possession without their knowledge. Fortunately, you know exactly where you put it! You call out to your allies, urging them to pull something out of a pocket or bag. Each of your allies within 100 feet who can perceive you can use a reaction to draw one item of your choice from their pocket, bag, or similar storage space. They can additionally stow an item as part of this reaction, if desired. You choose the drawn item for each ally individually, from among the items in your possession that weigh 1 Bulk or less.

name: Whirling Swipe
text: Requirements You're wielding a two-handed melee weapon. You swipe your weapon in a wide swing to create a deadly arc. Your weapon gains the area (burst 5 feet) and unwieldy traits until the end of the turn. If your weapon has reach, the burst radius becomes the reach of your weapon. Area Fire with the required weapon, centering the burst on a corner of a square you occupy. You're excluded from the burst. If you're using a weapon with the backswing or sweep trait, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the save DC of the attack. If you have the primary target class feature, the primary target Strike you make is a melee Strike, rather than a ranged Strike.

name: Whirling Swipe
text:
Requirements You're wielding a two-handed melee weapon.

You swipe your weapon in a wide swing to create a deadly arc. Your weapon gains the area (burst 5 feet) and unwieldy traits until the end of the turn. If your weapon has reach, the burst radius becomes the reach of your weapon. with the required weapon, centering the burst on a corner of a square you occupy. You're excluded from the burst. If you're using a weapon with the backswing or sweep trait, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the save DC of the attack. If you have the primary target class feature, the primary target Strike you make is a melee Strike, rather than a ranged Strike.

name: White Hat Hack
text: [free-action] Trigger: you cast a non-cantrip spell not modified by Jailbreak Spell. Requirements: your gear is overclocked. You reduce the glitching condition of up to one tech creature or item within 100 feet (per rank of the triggering spell) by half the spell's rank (minimum 1). For the next minute, affected targets roll glitching-recovery flat checks twice and take the higher result (a fortune effect).

name: Wide Field of View
text: Your eyes are set particularly far apart, even relative to other izalguuns, and with some focus you can keep track of all the threats around you. You gain all-around vision until the start of your next turn. This lets you see in all directions and prevents you from being flanked.

name: Wide-Spectrum Artiller Repulsion Device
text: You've integrated a Wide-Spectrum Artillery Repulsion Device, or WARD, into your LFAN that emits energy to absorb incoming projectiles.

name: Wide-Spectrum Artillery Repulsion Device
text: You've integrated a Wide-Spectrum Artillery Repulsion Device, or WARD, into your LFAN that emits energy to absorb incoming projectiles. The WARD is always active by default, but you can deactivate or reactivate it with a single Interact action. While your WARD is active, any damage you would take from a ranged attack is applied to the force field's Hit Points first before being applied to your Hit Points (including temporary Hit Points). If an attack reduces the WARD to 0 Hit Points, you take any excess damage, the WARD deactivates, and it can't be activated again for 10 minutes. Your WARD has ] Hit Points and regains ] Hit Points at the start of your turn. At 15th level and every 2 levels thereafter, increase the total Hit Points of your WARD by 3 and the amount of Hit Points it replenishes by 1.

name: Widen Area
text: Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon. You set up your area weapon to affect more targets. If the next action you use is to Area Fire or Auto-Fire in a burst, cone, or line, or if you use Whirling Swipe, you increase the area of that attack. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius isn't affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that's normally 15 feet or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.

name: Widen Area
text:
Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon.

You set up your area weapon to affect more targets. If the next action you use is to Area Fire or Auto-Fire in a burst, cone, or line, or if you use , you increase the area of that attack. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius isn't affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that's normally 15 feet or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.

name: Widen Spell
text: You manipulate the energy of your spell, causing it to affect a wider area. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and doesn't have a duration, increase the area of that spell. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius isn't affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that's normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.

name: Widen Spell
text: You manipulate the energy of your spell, causing it to affect a wider area. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and doesn't have a duration, increase the area of that spell. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius isn't affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that's normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.

name: Widen Spell (Starfinder)
text: You manipulate the energy of your spell, causing it to affect a wider area. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and doesn't have a duration, increase the area of that spell. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius isn't affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that's normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.

name: Widest Field of View
text: You can process enough visual information that you can see in all directions at once. You permanently gain all-around vision, meaning you can't be flanked. Additionally, you can [[/act seek]] in two directions at once.

name: Wild Bond
text: Understanding that all living things are part of the same tapestry of life, you can tap into the universal code to radically alter the genes of creatures in your bond. You gain the Wild Bond epiphany spell.

name: Wild Bond
text: Understanding that all living things are part of the same tapestry of life, you can tap into the universal code to radically alter the genes of creatures in your bond. You gain the epiphany spell.

name: Wild Soulfeel
text: You're as fickle as the inhabitants of the First World. When you use an action with both the emotion and moyishuu traits, you must immediately attune your soulfeel to a different emotion. If the action had a duration, it becomes until the end of your turn. You can attempt to keep the same emotional attunement by succeeding at a flat, but if you fail, the frequency of the action becomes once per hour.

name: Willful Defiance
text: You loudly proclaim your opposition to a single creature you're aware of within 60 feet. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Armor Class and saving throws against the selected creature's attacks, spells, and other effects for 1 minute. During that time, if you would fail or critically fail a saving throw against the selected creature, you can choose to reroll the failed save. If you do, after rerolling, Willful Defiance ends.

name: Wind Walker
text: Your skill at flying allows you to do it as easily as other species might walk. Whenever you Stride, you can Fly or use Basic Flight instead.

name: Wind Walker
text: Your skill at flying allows you to do it as easily as other species might walk. Whenever you Stride, you can Fly or use Basic Flight instead.

name: Wing Buffet
text: You lash out with powerful wings as you fly. When you make a Strike during aerial movement, you can simultaneously push one adjacent creature 5 feet (Fortitude DC 10 + level + STR modifier negates).

name: Witchwarper Dedication
text: You glimpse the infinite branches of reality. You gain access to two cantrips of your choice from the witchwarper spell list and a spell repertoire of those cantrips. You're trained in spell attack rolls and spell DCs using Intelligence as your spellcasting attribute. Special: You can't select another dedication feat until you've gained two other feats from the witchwarper archetype. (Prerequisite Intelligence 14 shown for reference; not enforced in-app.)

name: Without a Trace
text: You leave no evidence of your passing. When you successfully Sneak, you can also remove evidence of your trail, making it difficult to Track you.

name: Woodland Stride
text: Foliage and other plants part before you, as your magic encourages them to make your progress easier. You ignore any difficult terrain caused by plants, such as bushes, vines, and undergrowth. Even plants manipulated by magic don't impede your progress.

name: Work's Never Done
text: Your experience as a brood-minder has hardened you, and you can function fully with little to no rest. You require only two hours of sleep to get a full night's rest, rather than eight. You can use exploration activities when Fatigued.

name: Working Artist
text: People have noticed the originality and quality of your artistic creations, and you've started moonlighting as a professional artist. You become trained in Crafting or a Lore skill related to art (such as Art Lore or Sculpture Lore). When you succeed or critically succeed on a check to Earn Income using Crafting or a Lore skill related to art, calculate the amount you earn as if you'd attempted a check one level higher.

name: World Shards
text: Frequency once per day You call upon the spinning and beating hearts of every planet you've ever visited and share their true power with your enemies, unleashing a blast of superdense, red-hot iron shards. Each creature in a takes |options:area-damage] damage and |options:area-damage] damage with a basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. A creature that fails its save becomes suppressed until the end of your next turn. If you and your targets are in an underground environment, they don't get a bonus to their Reflex saves from standard cover against World Shards but still gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves if they have greater cover.

name: Wormhole
text: Frequency once per hour You force a rip in space that acts as a tunnel to a nearby location. Create two wormholes in unoccupied squares in line of effect that are within 100 feet, visible to you, and at least 15 feet apart. When a creature enters a wormhole's space, they emerge in an unoccupied space of their choice adjacent to the other wormhole. A creature that isn't flying treats all spaces lacking solid ground as occupied. If there's no valid space for the creature to enter, then both wormholes collapse and the creature remains in the space where it entered the first wormhole. The wormholes last for 1 round before collapsing, but you can Sustain the wormholes for up to 1 minute. Use your attunement when you take the Wormhole action to determine its attuned effects. Graviton-Attuned A creature beginning its turn adjacent to a wormhole must succeed at a fortitude|against:solarian|options:forced-movement save against your class DC or be pulled into the wormhole. Photon-Attuned A creature entering the wormhole becomes Concealed until the start of its next turn.

name: Wormhole
text:
Frequency once per hour

You force a rip in space that acts as a tunnel to a nearby location. Create two wormholes in unoccupied squares in line of effect that are within 100 feet, visible to you, and at least 15 feet apart. When a creature enters a wormhole's space, they emerge in an unoccupied space of their choice adjacent to the other wormhole. A creature that isn't flying treats all spaces lacking solid ground as occupied. If there's no valid space for the creature to enter, then both wormholes collapse and the creature remains in the space where it entered the first wormhole. The wormholes last for 1 round before collapsing, but you can Sustain the wormholes for up to 1 minute. Use your attunement when you take the Wormhole action to determine its attuned effects.

Graviton-Attuned A creature beginning its turn adjacent to a wormhole must succeed at a save against your class DC or be pulled into the wormhole.

Photon-Attuned A creature entering the wormhole becomes until the start of its next turn.

name: Wormhole Warren
text: Frequency once per hour You've realized the truth: that the universe is merely a series of tunnels, each connected individually by quantum particles into a massive and infinite warren. Create two wormholes, one adjacent to you, and one in an unoccupied square within 100 feet, visible to you, and at least 15 feet from the one adjacent to you. You immediately Step through the wormhole adjacent to you and appear at the other wormhole. The wormhole lasts for 1 round before collapsing, but you can Sustain the wormholes for up to 1 minute. Other ysoki can travel through your wormholes as well, but if a non-ysoki creature attempts to enter the wormhole, it automatically collapses.

name: Wriggling Contortionist
text: You can wriggle your way around tight spaces without much difficulty, making it hard for others to pin you down. You can ignore difficult terrain caused by moving through tight spaces that aren't tight enough to force you to Squeeze. If you roll a success to Squeeze, you get a critical success instead. Ignore any penalties to Speeds conferred by the suppressed condition.

name: Wriggling Tail
text: Trigger You become Grabbed. Requirements You have a fully grown tail. You disconnect and drop part of your tail to escape. You cease being grabbed then Step. It takes 1 day (or an effect like Regenerate) for your tail to fully grow back. Until it does, you can't use your tail, and you take a –2 circumstance penalty on checks to [[/act balance]]. Special If you have Ancestral Unarmed Attack (tail), you can eject your tail as a reaction when you take damage from an attack. If you do, you Step and one adjacent square becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute as your tail wriggles in place. If you also have the Feign Death skill feat, you can Feign Death instead of Stepping, with a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception DC.

name: Xenoarchaeologist Dedication
text:
You become an expert in Society and Thievery and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge checks and Delve Lore checks when using Investigate as your exploration activity.

You gain the Additional Lore general feat in Delve Lore, which you can use to Recall Knowledge about sites of archaeological significance, and about ancient history, relics, languages, and peoples. Upon gaining this skill, choose either Intelligence or Wisdom as the key attribute for your Delve Lore checks. This choice is permanent and can't be changed later.

Xenoarchaeologist

name: Xenodruid Bond
text: You join a primal order of xenodruids with ties to nature and the biodiversity of the Universe, such as the Xenowardens. Choose one of the following xenodruid orders. Order Animal; Skill Animal Lore; Spells 1st: Pest Form; 2nd: Animal Form; 5th: Carcinization Order Plant; Skill Plant Lore; Spells 1st: Summon Plant or Fungus; 2nd: Verdant Code; 5th: Plant Form Order Viral; Skill Genealogy Lore; Spells 1st: Detect Poison; 2nd: Instant Virus; 5th: Toxic Cloud You become trained in the listed skill associated with the order and add the listed spells to your spell list and spell repertoire as signature spells. If you were already trained in the listed skill, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice.

text:

You become trained in the listed skill associated with the order and add the listed spells to your spell list and spell repertoire as signature spells. If you were already trained in the listed skill, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice.

name: Xenodruid Dedication
text:
You can form a bond with the collective spirit of a world's ecosystems. This is a 10-minute activity that involves communing with nature and meditation. The planet must have an active biosphere. You can only bond with one planet at a time. This counts toward your maximum number of bonds. Planets don't count as creatures nor allies for the purposes of spells, prerequisites, or other abilities, including your vitality network.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge about your planet's life and natural occurrences. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to subsist in its wilds and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against environmental hazards and effects naturally found on your bonded planet. When off-world, you always know the general direction your planet lies in relation to you (but not distance), which grants a +1 circumstance bonus to Piloting checks to navigate.

In addition, you can assess the health of your planet once per day and attempt to locate any major disturbances to its ecosystems. Attempt a check while in contact with your planet.

Critical Success You diagnose the planet's health through its various ecospheres. In addition, you can detect specific ongoing disturbances to the natural world—such as industrial mining or a fire in a particular valley. You can sense the distance and direction of the disturbance and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against hazards created by this disturbance.

Success As a critical success, but you can only sense disturbances happening on a massive scale (such as hurricanes, volcanic eruptions, or planetwide pollution) and the direction to it.

Failure You diagnose the planet's health but don't identify any disturbances.
Special You can take this feat if you have the mystic multiclass archetype dedication feat even if you haven't taken two additional mystic feats. Mystic archetype feats count as xenodruid feats, and vice-versa, for purposes of completing the archetypes.

Xenodruid

name: Xenogourmand
text: You love to cook anything you find, even if you really shouldn't. You gain the feat with Cooking Lore. You can spend thirty minutes preparing and serving a meal for up to 5 living creatures; when you do so, partaking creatures must attempt a save against your Cooking Lore DC. Your targets are then temporarily immune to xenogourmand for 1 day. Critical Success The creature feels nourished; they're full for the day and gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level for 1 day. Success The creature is full for a few hours and gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level for two hours. Critical Failure Your meal doesn't sit well with the creature's stomach. Unless they're goblins, they're Sickened 1 and can't reduce their sickened value for 10 minutes.

name: Yaraesa's Antennae
text: Field agents of the Informational Safety Board and clergy of the Glory In Knowledge Museum codeveloped methods to biomagically cultivate telepathic sensory organs, and you've undergone their regimens and rituals to better serve Yaraesa. You gain limited telepathy, allowing you to communicate mentally with creatures within 30 feet that share a language with you, and they can mentally respond. This doesn't give you any access to their thoughts and communicates no more information than normal speech would.

name: You Can Do It
text: Requirements Your last action was a 1-action directive. You motivate an ally within 60 feet to lead by example. As a free action, that ally can immediately perform the lead by example actions of your last action, gaining any benefits and using any abilities that would normally be used as if you used two-actions to issue the direction. Use your Charisma modifier instead of your ally's when determining any relevant benefits, such as the status bonus to damage for Get 'Em!

name: You Can't Teach Speed
text: Frequency once per day Sometimes, you need to ignore your own limits and run just a little bit faster. When circumstances are dire, you can draw on an inner strength and push your body to go even faster than usual. You gain the Quickened condition for 3 rounds. You can use the extra action only to [[/act long-jump]] or Stride.

name: You Should See the Other Guy
text: Frequency once every 10 minutes Trigger A creature you can sense critically succeeds on a Strike against you. You can't stand being shown up in battle, and those who best you face your swift retribution. You Strike the triggering creature.

name: You'll Have to Go Through Me!
text: You brace yourself as you prepare to defend your allies behind you. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire. Until the start of your next turn or until you use a move action, whichever happens first, you gain the Living Shield reaction and, if you would be moved by a forced movement effect, you move 10 feet less.

name: You've Got MAIL
text: Frequency once every 10 minutes You have a MAIL (Messaging Augmentation Integrated LFAN), which allows you to efficiently communicate information to others by translating it into a form that can be efficiently transmitted to their nervous system. You use your LFAN to transmit information to the nervous system of an adjacent willing creature, imparting to that target an amount of information in an instant that could otherwise be communicated in 10 minutes. Special As long as you have a MAIL, you gain a special form of limited telepathy that allows you to communicate mentally with any raxilite within 30 feet as long as they share a language with you.

name: Your Lucky Number
text: You've refined your relationship with the most fickle force in the universe, and you can tap into it with an expertise that people all over the galaxy would envy. At the beginning of each adventuring day, roll 1d20. This number is your lucky number, and the first time you roll it on an attack, check, or save, treat the roll as a 20. If you roll a 20, your lucky number becomes 1 instead.

name: Ysoki Lore
text: Years of experience living among ysoki communities have trained your nimble steps and sneaky moves. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the general feat for Ysoki Lore.

name: Zero-G Tail
text: You can use your nimble tail to maneuver in zero gravity. You can Float up to your Speed when you Push Off using your tail instead of up to half your Speed. In addition, you can spend your reaction to [[/act grab-an-edge]] at any point in your movement while Floating that you pass adjacent to an object, halting your movement immediately if you succeed at your check.

name: Zero-G Training
text: You have spent time working in zero gravity and are able to keep your stomach even when floating freely. The interior of asteroids or ships that have lost power are easily navigable for you. You can use your legs to while in zero-g without needing a free hand. You can ignore the and penalties while in zero gravity.

name: Zone Overlap
text: Requirements Your quantum field is active with one zone affecting it. You cause a second zone to overlap your quantum field. You can choose to apply another zone you're able to create, or apply the existing zone again, improving its effects as follows: Danger Zone deals 1 extra damage, Debris Zone becomes greater difficult terrain, and Twisted Dark Zone ignores the temporary immunity of creatures that previously critically succeeded at the save for 1 round.

name: Zoomies
text: Frequency once per day You unleash your pent up energy in a flurry of unpredictable motion. You gain the Quickened condition for 4 rounds. You can use the extra action each round only to Stride.
